briefdescription.para: Socket server of the daemon: accepts client connections, writes the port file, broadcasts notifications, and exits when idle or replaced.

detaileddescription.para: Listens on a system-assigned loopback port. When the files child is added to the model, writes the bound port (or noPort if empty) to the port file and starts the idle timer when no connections are open. A connection added to Id::connections stops the idle timer, and removing the last connection restarts it. When the timer expires or the running executable changes on disk, the server stops the socket, deletes the port file, and quits the application.
